about: Batch 0c of docs/UI2_DESIGN.md 5.13 (D57): Yuji's blink and talking mouth, bought again from his new calm face. Written on 12 Oct 2026, after wave 0 was merged, by the art-install role.

Nothing of Yuji's is in the game yet. His whole set goes in in one step, tools/install_set.py yuji, once these two pictures are back: six sprites, six side portraits, the two overlay pictures and his eye and mouth boxes.
The pictures stay where they are made, in ~/Desktop/JJK Game images/redo_yuji/ ; this file holds their names and sums.

from.calm: redo_yuji/yuji_base.png (1536x2752, flat green; chosen on 7 Oct, O29 to O32)
from.five faces: redo_yuji/composited/yuji_<face>.png (batch 0b, laid onto the calm picture on 7 Oct)

read_2026_10_12.the tool: each of the six: 18 edge pixels still carry the backdrop's colour (0.002% of the figure)
read_2026_10_12.keyedge.py --check, on a full-size cut-o: 0 strongly tinted px, 53 faintly, 0 pockets left solid
read_2026_10_12.cutcheck.py, the same: a piece cut off: 57 px in 2 places, at (1055, 2409) and (573, 2386) of the render; a gap left filled: 0; stray marks: 15 px in 12 places, none as large as 12 px; fainter specks: 678 px, each under a tenth solid
by eye: The two places cutcheck names are the insides of the two shoelace loops: the backdrop shows through them in the render and they are rightly clear in the cut-out; a sliver of the lace's own shadow inside each keeps a faint green cast, a couple of pixels at the game's size.

On a light and a dark ground, whole and at three times the size (hair, a hand, the shoes): no green fringe, no hole, no piece missing. A dotted line of the fainter specks beside the trouser's edge can be made out at three times the size on a dark ground and not at the size the game draws.
The six share one body: each other face differs from the calm sprite only inside the box (330, 276) to (413, 382) of the 760x1400 canvas.
He stands as today's Yuji does: 1,146 px tall on the canvas, his head at y 220 and his soles at y 1365.
read_2026_10_12.sheets: shots/yuji/ (ignored by git): whole_old_new.jpg, heads_six.jpg, edges_3x.jpg, cutcheck_places.jpg, closeup_old_new.jpg

close_up.cut: a 309 px square of the staged calm sprite at (218, 208), on flat green, enlarged to 1024x1024 (redo_yuji/masks/yuji_fx_crop.txt)
close_up.file: redo_yuji/yuji_fx_in.png, copied as yuji_new_fx_in.png into ~/Desktop/JJK Game images/ and ComfyUI's input folder

workflow.cost: about $0.32 (Nano Banana Pro, one version each: they are laid over a sprite that is already chosen)
workflow.written_by_hand_because: tools/make_edit_workflow.py reads the close-up only from ~/Desktop/JJK Game images/yuji_fx_in.png, which is still the close-up of today's Yuji (4 Oct), and saves under the names that run used (yuji_blink_nanobanana_00001_ and yuji_talk_nanobanana_00001_ are in ComfyUI's output from then). The workflow was built by the tool's own build(), its wording unchanged, with the input named yuji_new_fx_in.png and the results yuji_new_..., so that nothing of the old drawing can be taken for the new. The tool has no --images option yet: a redrawn person's close-up is written by install_face.py --prepare --images into the staging folder, where make_edit_workflow.py does not look.

after_the_owner_has_run_it: python3 tools/install_face.py ~/ComfyUI-Shared/output/yuji_new_blink_nanobanana_00001_.png yuji blink --sprite '<staged>/char/yuji_neutral.png' --images '~/Desktop/JJK Game images/redo_yuji' --stage '<staged>'

python3 tools/install_face.py ~/ComfyUI-Shared/output/yuji_new_talk_nanobanana_00001_.png yuji talk --sprite '<staged>/char/yuji_neutral.png' --images '~/Desktop/JJK Game images/redo_yuji' --stage '<staged>'
Read shots/art/fx_yuji_blink.png, fx_yuji_talk.png and fx_yuji_blink_faces.png (which faces take the blink) before going on.

python3 tools/install_set.py yuji '<staged>' --dry ; then, with the game closed and game/*.rpyc backed up, without --dry: the fourteen pictures, his faces.json rows, the uniform's cloth (cloth_match.py --apply yuji --redrawn) and game/jjk_sprites.rpy regenerated.

Afterwards (docs/UI2_CONTRACTS.md A2): tools/smoke.sh u2_baseline, and tools/smoke/baseline_sprite_tree.txt written again once its tree line has passed; tools/load_all_saves.sh; every harness that shows Yuji; tools/smoke.sh u2_dump and the art tools' suite.

renders.made: run by the owner on 12 Oct 2026 at 11:37; each PNG's own record names yuji_new_fx_in.png as the picture it was made from

read_renders_2026_10_12.blink: eyes box [326, 300, 92, 40], measured on the new sprite; the staged overlay differs from the calm sprite only inside it. The eyes close to two soft curved lines; the brows inside the box are drawn a little lighter, as in the blink today's Yuji has. It sits on no other face: happy, serious, angry, surprised and sad each keep their own eyes (their rims differ by 8.1 to 19.0 on average, 4.9% to 13.1% strongly). Today's Yuji blinks on four other faces (happy, sad, serious, surprised); the new one on the calm face only.
read_renders_2026_10_12.talk: mouth box [346, 344, 52, 36]; lined up at scale 1.0000 with no shift; the rim differs from the sprite by 4.1 on average. The mouth opens in a small oval with the upper teeth showing, the same shape and size as today's; its inside is greyer than today's pink.
read_renders_2026_10_12.the whole set, dry: python3 tools/install_set.py yuji <staged> --dry : all fourteen pictures are here, on the 760x1400 canvas; the six share one body; the two overlay pictures differ from the calm sprite only inside their boxes (nothing written)
read_renders_2026_10_12.sheets: shots/art/fx_yuji_blink.png, fx_yuji_talk.png, fx_yuji_blink_faces.png; shots/yuji/old_new_blink_talk.jpg (today's calm, blink and talk above the new ones), blink_talk_staged.jpg
